intro: The Central African Republic is a landlocked plateau of savanna and rainforest.

chapters.title: Land
text: The Ubangi River forms the southern border. Dzanga-Sangha in the south-west has forest elephants that gather in a clearing called Dzanga Bai. The north is savanna.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The south is hot and wet; the north has a dry season.

keyTerms.meaning: A forest clearing where animals gather.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of the Central African Republic's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
